blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu- A 28-year-old construction worker was stabbed and killed in Sitio Ylaya, Barangay Bolinawan, Carcar City, at 1:00 a.m. on Monday, Nov. 23, 2026. Authorities identified the victim as alias Ron, who hailed from Ormoc City, Leyte but until recently lived in Barangay Bolinawan. The authorities also identified the suspect as alias Gin, of legal age, a construction worker and a resident of Bais, City, Negros Occidental.
